items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Maximum loss allowed within one trading day. Trading day runs from 17:00:00 NY Time to 16:59:59 NY Time the following day. Open equity and floating losses are included. Static — does not trail upward. Hard Breach = immediate account termination.

items.label: Maximum Drawdown
items.detail: Total loss allowed from the Initial Account Balance. Static — does not trail upward with profits and does not adjust based on the highest account balance reached. Open equity and floating losses are included. Hard Breach = immediate account termination.

items.label: Floating DD — Early Reminder
items.detail: An early soft reminder is issued when the combined unrealised loss on any single symbol reaches 1.0% of the Initial Account Balance. No Strike applied at this stage. Example: $50K account → soft reminder at −$500 on any one symbol.

items.label: Floating DD — Breach
items.detail: Floating Drawdown is monitored on a combined basis per symbol and calculated against the Initial Account Balance. Threshold is 1.5%. First confirmed 1.5% breach = Formal Warning only — no Strike, no payout reduction. From the second confirmed breach onward: 1 Strike + payout reduction to 10% for the relevant payout cycle. Only one Strike may be issued per trade or instrument. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: Instant funding — no evaluation, no profit target required.

items.label: Minimum Profitable Days
items.detail: 5 profitable days required per 14-day payout cycle before each payout. A profitable day is a trading day where the account balance at 17:00:00 NY Time exceeds the previous trading day's closing balance by at least 0.5% of the Initial Account Balance. No payout is permitted until the requirement is met.

items.label: Consistency Rule
items.detail: No consistency requirement for this account type.

items.label: Default Rule
items.detail: Weekend holding is not permitted by default on Instant Funding Lite accounts. All non-crypto positions must be closed before Friday market close at 17:00:00 New York Time unless the Weekend Holding Add-On is active. Traders without the add-on will receive an automatic reminder one hour before market close and are advised to close positions at least 10 minutes before the cutoff.

items.label: Breach Consequence
items.detail: A Weekend Holding breach results in: 1 Strike, payout reduction to 10% for the relevant payout cycle. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Realised-Loss Recovery Trading
items.detail: Two-trade basis on same symbol. Second trade cumulative volume must remain below twice the first trade's reference volume. First confirmed breach = Formal Warning only. Second breach onward = 1 Strike + payout reduction to 10%. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Scalping
items.detail: 40%+ of closed trades ≤ 120 sec, OR 20%+ of total positive realised profit from trades ≤ 120 sec. If active at payout: 1 Conditional Strike + payout to 10%.

items.label: Excessive One-Sided Position Concentration
items.detail: ≥ 10 closed trades AND 70%+ of trades OR 70%+ of exposure on same symbol & direction. If active at payout: 1 Conditional Strike + payout to 10%.

items.label: Liquidity Abuse
items.detail: ≥ 20% of total realised profit from trades opened & closed within low-liquidity window (Global 22:00–01:59 UTC; Asian 22:00–00:59 UTC). If active at payout: 1 Conditional Strike + payout to 10%.

items.label: Disproportionate Single-Trade Profit Dependency
items.detail: Within a payout cycle, single most profitable closed trade contributes 60%+ of total positive realised profit. Assessed at payout time only. If active at payout: 1 Conditional Strike + payout to 10%.

items.label: High-Frequency Trading
items.detail: 30%+ of closed trades < 60 sec (minimum 10 closed trades), OR 5+ trades opened within any 10-second interval. Referred to Risk and Compliance team for review.

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Triggered by: (1) Daily Drawdown breach, (2) Maximum Drawdown breach, or (3) Five cumulative Strikes.

items.label: Soft Breach — Immediate Strike
items.detail: Notional Volume breach + Weekend Holding breach = Immediate Strike + payout reduction to 10%.

items.label: Soft Breach — Warning-Based
items.detail: Floating Drawdown (≥ 1.5%) + Realised-Loss Recovery = first breach Formal Warning, second breach onward Strike + payout to 10%.

items.label: Soft Breach — Conditional
items.value: If not reversed before payout: 1 Strike + payout to 10%
items.detail: Scalping, Concentration, Liquidity Abuse, Single-Trade Profit Dependency = Conditional Strike applied at payout if condition remains active.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Starting split for all Instant Funding Lite accounts.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: First payout on-demand after 5 minimum profitable days met. Subsequent payouts every 14 days.

items.label: Min Profitable Days
items.detail: Must complete 5 profitable days (≥ 0.5% each) per 14-day cycle before each payout. Counter resets after every payout.

items.label: Payout Reduction
items.detail: Each Strike reduces the relevant payout cycle to 10%. If a Strike has been issued, trader must withdraw the full available amount — partial withdrawal is not permitted.
